target_customer: Architecture and structural engineering firms that need to manage and reuse design details and Revit content
problem: Firms repeatedly redraw design details because past work is hard to find; Pirros searches firm content by condition and places vetted details into Revit.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription to AECO firms
product_category: Design content management and AI for architecture and engineering

founders.name: Ari Baranian
prior_employers: A national structural engineering company (led its software development group)
founders.background_notes: Structural engineer turned entrepreneur per company release. Education not found.

founders.name: Peter Johann
prior_employers: Structural engineering firm in Los Angeles
founders.background_notes: Structural engineer per YC page. Education not found.

technical_complexity.rationale: Parsing geometry and notes in CAD and Revit details and integrating into Revit is standard engineering with some hard parts.

defensibility.rationale: Once a firm's detail library and standards live in the system it is sticky, and domain experience from the founders helps; competing detail tools existed.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows Autodesk copying or buying it; a former Autodesk CEO invested as an angel.

market_need_then: Architecture and engineering firms had underinvested in software for managing design details; the company cites a $12T plus industry underserved by technology.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and practical, tagline Be the firm that remembers everything

branding.brand_signature: Tagline: Be the firm that remembers everything
branding.community_and_virality: Hosts webinars such as a Revit families guide; no evidence of viral community.

brand_strength.rationale: Clear tagline and logos of large engineering firms, but no press about the brand itself and the name is easily confused with similar words.

pivots.to: AI project hub with Mira AI engine, quality management and content intelligence
pivots.why: Series A funds were pointed at content intelligence and quality management per the company release

outcome_analysis: Two structural engineers built a niche tool, took a $2M seed in August 2023 and say they were profitable since. They raised a $15M Series A in December 2025 led by Elephant Ventures and claim 450 firms. The company-reported figures are unaudited, but the path shows capital efficiency and domain fit.
notes: The YC page says a Series A of about $17M; the company's own release says $15M, and $2M plus $15M gives about $17M, so the $17M is a combined figure, not a round. Revenue and profitability claims (about $6M ARR) are company self-reports. Seed date is the company release date; investor lists differ slightly across outlets. FinSMEs reported 30 plus customers including KPFF and RAMSA at the seed. Competitors named on later pages (utecture, o2c, Framing) are undated, so the list is empty. Founder education not found.
